messages:
Ashley: Quick heads-up — planning a staggered routing policy swap for EU-edge tomorrow 21:00 UTC. Goal: shift traffic to new steer policy (more aggressive failover) in steps. Who will do the policy flip and DNS update? Need smoke checks, rollback readiness, and a primary watcher.

Sam: I can run the policy swap. Plan: 21:00 start, rollout 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 5m between steps. Will announce each step here.

Ming: I'll own smoke checks and metrics. Smoke checklist (quick):
```
1) curl -sS -H "Host: api.eu.redwood" https://eu-edge.internal/health | grep OK
2) curl -sS "https://eu-edge.internal/ping?test=1" -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
3) verify p95 latency < 120ms on /v1/generate for a 32-token prompt
4) check KV cache hitrate > 85% for model endpoints
```
I'll watch grafana: dashboards/team-inference / dashboards/edge-eu. If any step fails (5xxs or p95 > 30% above baseline) call rollback.

Jordan: I'll monitor SLOs and error budget. Rollback triggers: error rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR 30% p95 regression. I'll be prepared to flip weights back and open an incident channel if needed.

Priya: Rollback playbook is ready. TL;DR: set route weights back to previous percentages, revert any route-level filters, and reduce TTL to 60s during the swap. Full runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/rollbacks/route-swap (link).

Mateo: I'll do the DNS side if needed — note that console TTL is set to 300s now; I'll lower to 60s 10m before start. After 100% complete we'll raise TTL back to 300s.

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: route-policy-swap-eu at 2026-04-01T21:00:00Z. Notifying oncall.

Sam: Small note — we'll use canary headers for initial 10% so dev traffic can still be routed to v1. Steps I'll post as: "step-start", "step-check", "step-promote".

Ashley: Who can be standby for deploy command if Sam is delayed?

Jordan: I can take over if Sam gets pulled.

Priya: I'll be available for rollback ops and to coordinate with security if any audit events fire.

Ming: Quick Q: do we need to mute automated autoscaler during the window? Autoscaler may spin extra capacity and skew metrics.

Sam: Good catch — yes please disable autoscale-policy eu-inference-autoscale 10m before start. I'll re-enable after final step.

Mateo: I'll lower TTL at 20:50 UTC and post when done.

Ashley: Go/no-go call at 20:50 UTC in this thread. If no blockers, proceed. I'll be primary oncall and reachable on phone.

Sam: Copy, will post step messages. Logging commands used in audit channel: `rbacctl deploy route-policy --id rp-eu-2026`

Ming: I'll run the smoke commands 30s after each step and post a short summary like: `step 10% -> ok, p95 96ms, errors 0.02%`

Jordan: I'll post SLO snapshot before and after each step. If I see noise > threshold I will say ROLLBACK.

Priya: Rollback quick command: `routectl set-weight rp-eu-2026 previous` — tested in staging.

Sam: All set from my side. Posting the step timestamps in case anyone needs to plan: 21:00, 21:05, 21:10, 21:15.

Ashley: Thanks team. Please react here with :thumbsup: when ready.

Ming: :thumbsup:

Jordan: :thumbsup:

Priya: :thumbsup:

Mateo: :thumbsup:

Sam: :thumbsup: starting prechecks at 20:40 UTC.
